sloka: अमी हि विविधैः पुष्पैः तरवो रुचिर च्छदाः  ।कानने अस्मिन् विना कान्ताम् चित्तम् उत्पादयन्ति मे  ॥४-१-९७॥
transliteration: amī hi vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taravo rucira cchadāḥ  ।kānane asmin vinā kāntām cittam utpādayanti me  ॥4-1-97॥

translations.english: 'These trees with their beautiful leaves and varieties of flowers bring me agony as I live in this forest separated from my beloved.
